_doc: Presentation tunables only (no rule numbers). Sizes are canvas units, about 1 dp on phones and tablets (scripts/platform/display_scale.gd). auction_quick_bid_steps: raise amounts shown as buttons in the auction panel; the minimum legal bid always comes from rules.json. The match board always takes the full short side of the play area (P5-FEEL Dig 5, board-first); the turn panel and the board overlay float over the screen and never resize it (turn_panel_doc, overlay_doc). trade_cash_steps: +/- buttons beside the trade cash fields. bot_step_seconds: pause between bot actions so people can follow. setup_*: seat setup screen (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q19): seat counts offered, the minimum number of people needed to start, and each seat's Human/Bot default (true = bot).
theme_path_doc: visual theme pack (colors, StyleBoxes, board chrome); see docs/THEME_MAP.md
motion_doc: P4-DEMO motion and dialogue timings (seconds; TODO tune on device, docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q21). dice_roll_seconds: dice tumble before the faces settle. pawn_step_seconds: one hop per space; pawn_move_max_seconds caps a long move (card advances) by speeding hops up. pawn_jump_seconds: straight arc to the Brig. pawn_hop_height: hop lift as a share of a board cell. banner_seconds: how long a line stays when nothing waits; banner_backlog_seconds when more lines wait; banner_max_queue: waiting lines kept (oldest dropped). bot_wait_banner_queue: bots pause while more than this many lines wait. panel_fade_seconds: auction / debt / trade / section fades; screen_fade_seconds: setup and match screens; pulse_seconds: banner flash.
bot_auction_step_seconds_doc: pause between bot auction bids (bots raise in $1 steps, so auctions need a quicker pace)
dice_bounce_doc: Q21 B1: normalized roll fractions mark release, first impact, rebound release and final impact; heights/spread are board-cell shares. Two parabolic hops with compression/stretch and impact settle, sampled by BoardView.advance. TODO Q21: tune on device.
victory_seconds_doc: Victory sweep, laurel and two winner hops on the single queue. TODO Q21 tune on device.
victory_sweep_seconds_doc: Expanding winner ring duration. TODO Q21 tune on device.
victory_laurel_seconds_doc: Vector laurel growth after the sweep. TODO Q21 tune on device.
victory_hop_height_doc: First winner hop in board cells. TODO Q21 tune on device.
victory_second_hop_height_doc: Second winner hop in board cells. TODO Q21 tune on device.
gate_arrival_seconds_doc: Railroad arrival ring and owner-border pulse. TODO Q21 tune on device.
gate_count_step_seconds_doc: One owned railroad border blink per step after claim. TODO Q21 tune on device.
anchor_seconds_doc: Free Parking orbit and tether rest beat before the card. No money effect. TODO Q21 tune on device.
anchor_settle_height_doc: Soft rest settle in board cells, decays during the first half. TODO Q21 tune on device.
go_flourish_seconds_doc: GO crossing beat inside the move; clipped at final arrival so move duration stays unchanged. TODO Q21 tune on device.
go_tag_height_doc: Salary tag arc in board cells. TODO Q21 tune on device.
go_hop_boost_doc: Crossing hop lift multiplier; no other hop is changed. TODO Q21 tune on device.
claim_seconds_doc: Owner-bar paint and claim hop duration. TODO Q21 tune on device.
claim_hop_height_doc: Claim hop height in board cells. TODO Q21 tune on device.
gavel_seconds_doc: Auction opening border and gavel beat. TODO Q21 tune on device.
cash_fly_light_seconds_doc: Smaller tax payment duration. TODO Q21 tune on device.
cash_fly_height_doc: Cash tag arc height in board cells. TODO Q21 tune on device.
cash_fly_light_height_factor_doc: Luxury-tax arc height relative to the standard fly. TODO Q21 tune on device.
cash_fly_stall_fraction_doc: Owed-money arc stalls short of receipt then returns. TODO Q21 tune on device.
cash_fly_return_shake_doc: Failed tag return shake in board cells. TODO Q21 tune on device.
cash_fly_seconds_doc: Shared transient money arc duration. TODO Q21 tune on device.
dice_press_depth_doc: Press compression within the existing release fraction. TODO Q21 tune on device.
dice_pip_lock_extra_doc: Pip radius overshoot during final settle. TODO Q21 tune on device.
dice_ready_period_seconds_doc: Idle ready-ring breathing period; never holds busy. TODO Q21 tune on device.
dice_tumble_fast_seconds_doc: Face-change interval at the start of a queued dice tumble (visual RNG only). TODO Q21: tune on Fold.
dice_tumble_slow_seconds_doc: Face-change interval as a queued dice tumble settles. TODO Q21: tune on Fold.
land_card_doc: Q21 B2: total lifetime in seconds. Normalized keyframes: arrival arc, squash impact, rebound settle, reading hold, windup, curved exit. Arc height in board cells. Board animation queue serializes cards and gates controls. TODO Q21 device tune; a long toast stops at the banner reservation (Q22 truncate-to-reserve).
turn_panel_enter_seconds_doc: Turn panel alpha entrance after the board queue settles; input follows MatchGate. TODO Q21: tune on Fold.
turn_panel_exit_seconds_doc: Turn panel alpha exit; presses are blocked immediately when hiding starts. TODO Q21: tune on Fold.
setup_min_humans_TODO: at least one person by default; all-bot matches stay possible in GameSetup for headless soak (docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q19)
main_menu_doc: MAIN_MENU_STARK pre-match main menu (scripts/ui/main_menu.gd): gel / tactile chrome (profile pill, round Social and Settings buttons, floating GO tile with a metal token and a glass die, left promo card, SHOP pill, massive PLAY pill) over the moving MainMenuBackground. colors are the chrome look and stay the same in every theme pack; each pack's menu_background section colors and moves the backdrop. Sizes in canvas units (about 1 dp); *_share values are shares of the safe screen width; float_seconds / die_spin_seconds are loop periods. The *_placeholder texts and numbers stand in for a profile backend, events and a store, none of which exist yet. TODO: tune on device (Fold).
overlay_doc: P5-FEEL Dig 5a2 board overlay (auction bid, debt + Holdings, trade answer, and Holdings / Trade / Log via Action): floats in the play area less the side panel's strip (side_panel_doc), in the free band after the board when it is at least overlay_min_width wide and tall enough; in portrait where that band is too short (Q22 1B) it docks at the bottom (closed: its content height at the bottom, below the dialogue banner; open: from the banner's top to the play bottom, over the banner, the one exception to keeping clear of it); else across the play width above or below the dialogue banner; the board never resizes for it. Canvas units: width at most overlay_max_width; full area height while its sections are open, else its content height.
turn_panel_doc: P5-FEEL Dig 5 turn panel (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q23): floats in the play area less the side panel's strip (side_panel_doc), in the free band after the board, else over the board center clear of the dialogue banner (also where an open overlay docks over the banner, Q22 1B); the board never resizes for it. Canvas units: width at most turn_panel_max_width and at least turn_panel_min_width; buttons sit in two columns from turn_panel_two_column_width.
side_panel_doc: P5 SIDE_PANEL per-seat side panel (scripts/ui/side_panel.gd; placed by Main.layout_rects since SIDE_PANEL_A2): one card per seat in a strip of the screen the panel owns, at the play area's far edge across its whole length (the bottom in portrait, the right in landscape); nothing else draws there (the turn panel and the board overlay float in the play area less the strip). One row when the strip is wider than tall, else one column. A full card shows the seat token over its cash plus name, deeds owned, net worth and badges; a compact card the token over the cash. Canvas units (about 1 dp). side_card_min_size: no card is smaller either way (Shibi: about 50). side_card_max_width / side_card_max_height: card size caps; spare strip stays empty, cards centred. side_card_gap: between cards. In a card, side_active_border_width (the active seat's border, never changed at run time) plus side_card_padding is the content inset; side_token_size; side_line_gap between text lines; side_column_gap between the token column and the details and between badges. side_token_piece_min_size: below it the token is a colour disc with the seat number instead of the seat piece. side_tint_alpha: seat colour over the theme panel colour (Shibi Oct 29 2026: 0.2; keep it light so theme text stays readable). side_money_sample: the figure cards are measured with (a wider figure grows its label); above it a compact card's cash and a full card's net worth show short (three significant digits, k / M: $12.5k; Shibi Oct 29 2026). Strip (SIDE_PANEL_A2, _placeholder picks from the A2 review's table): side_strip_pad around the cards inside the strip; the strip is deep enough for full cards (full minimum across + 2 x side_strip_pad) where the free band after the board is that deep, full cards fit along it and it still leaves the floats side_strip_full_keep_h (portrait) / side_strip_full_keep_w (landscape) beside the screen margins, else for compact cards (side_card_min_size + 2 x side_strip_pad). side_dock_min_h (Shibi Oct 30 2026; _placeholder value): in portrait the open bottom dock above the strip is at least this tall (the Trade card up to 6 seats), the board shrinking as much as that needs (of the probe sizes only 360x640: board 344 -> 259). Every other side_* number is a _placeholder pick. TODO: tune on device (Fold).
